_note: Every entry here was resolved or measured against the live API. `expect` fields are assertions, not guesses. Sources noted per case.

ground_truth_earliest.name: first_tweet_ever
ground_truth_earliest.why: Jack Dorsey's first tweet. Bisect+exhaust returned exactly id 20 in 15 requests. The single hardest ground truth available because the window is sparse but the phrase was copied hundreds of times in 2006.

ground_truth_earliest.name: covfefe_deleted_root
ground_truth_earliest.why: The root no longer exists. The tool should land within seconds of it and must NOT claim to have found the origin. Measured: earliest surviving is 04:06:26Z, 26s after the true post.

ambiguity_collisions.name: ok_boomer_football_chant
ambiguity_collisions.why: FALSE POSITIVE. 'Boomer Sooner' is the University of Oklahoma fight song. Naive earliest-string-match returns a 2008 tweet with 0 likes that has nothing to do with the meme. The volume curve exposes it: 1 match in Nov 2008 against 897,135 in Nov 2019.

ambiguity_collisions.name: ssi_korean_honorific
ambiguity_collisions.collision_text: Happy birthday, Soleum-ssi. I apologize for my delay.
ambiguity_collisions.why: FALSE POSITIVE. '-ssi' is a Korean honorific suffix. A string matcher cannot tell a company acronym from a politeness marker in another language. Cross-encoder scored this 0.0343.

paraphrase_recall.name: ssi_restated
paraphrase_recall.reference: ssi are delayed after a catastrophic security incident discovered after seeing what happened with openai, order of magnitude more damage caused.
paraphrase_recall.paraphrase: Safe Superintelligence has pushed back its timeline following a serious breach
paraphrase_recall.why: SAME CLAIM, different words. The off-the-shelf cross-encoder scores it 0.1332, below any usable threshold. This is the single clearest justification for fine-tuning, and the number to beat.
paraphrase_recall.note: A cross-encoder score depends on BOTH texts. Measured 0.1332 against a short hand-written query and 0.2880 against the full claim, so a fixture must record the query it used. Either way it sits below the 0.5 threshold.

paraphrase_recall.name: morphological_inflection
paraphrase_recall.why: Inflection alone hides 12% of volume from an exact-phrase query. Cheap to fix with morphological expansion; no model needed for this specific gap.

routing.name: recent_spike_verify
routing.why: Measured VERIFY when the claim was 2 hours old (pre-spike 1). Re-measured LINEAGE a day later (pre-spike 21), because yesterday's posts are now history relative to today's peak. ROUTING IS TIME-RELATIVE, so an absolute route label in a fixture goes stale. Assert the property instead: near-zero pre-spike volume routes VERIFY.

routing.name: essay_title_has_no_history
routing.why: COUNTERINTUITIVE BUT CORRECT. The essay TITLE has only 3 posts in the 30 days before the spike (Aug 17, Aug 25, Sep 9 - one each), so there is no history to trace and the correct mode is corroboration. Caught by a failing test that I initially assumed was a router bug.

routing.name: phrase_has_history_lineage
routing.why: The PHRASE, unlike the title, has a clear pre-spike ramp. Routing must therefore key on pre-spike volume, not on whether the spike is recent.

corroboration.name: single_source_uncorroborated
corroboration.why: The adjacent premise carries 160 against the claim's 28. The claim is borrowing credibility from a genuine ongoing OpenAI security story (4,500 posts over 14 days, sustained). 90% retweet share means one source amplified, not many reporting.
